# The site icon is copied to the root of the output under a fixed name
# and linked from every page, relative to the page.

md2html -html out -favicon art/logo.svg docs
cmp out/favicon.svg art/logo.svg
grep -q '<link rel="icon" href="./favicon.svg">' out/index.html
grep -q '<link rel="icon" href="../favicon.svg">' out/guide/start.html

md2html -html dirs -html-layout dir -favicon art/logo.svg docs
grep -q '<link rel="icon" href="../../favicon.svg">' dirs/guide/start/index.html

# Without the flag the icon is the one docs.json names, even when the
# navigation comes from SUMMARY.md.
md2html -nav -html fromjson docs
cmp fromjson/favicon.png docs/img/icon.png
grep -q '<link rel="icon" href="../favicon.png">' fromjson/guide/start.html

# A site without one links none.
md2html -html plain plain-src
! grep 'rel="icon"' plain/index.html

# A file named on the command line must be there, and be an image.
! md2html -html bad -favicon art/gone.svg docs
stderr 'favicon: .*gone.svg'
! md2html -html bad -favicon docs/index.md docs
stderr 'favicon: .*not an image'

# The server serves it.
md2html -http :9146 -favicon art/logo.svg docs &
wait-port :9146
curl -s http://localhost:9146/favicon.svg
stdout '<svg'
curl -s http://localhost:9146/guide/start
stdout '<link rel="icon" href="[./]*favicon.svg">'

-- art/logo.svg --
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1 1"><rect width="1" height="1"/></svg>
-- docs/docs.json --
{"name": "Site", "favicon": "/img/icon.png"}
-- docs/img/icon.png --
not really a png
-- docs/SUMMARY.md --
# Summary

- [Home](index.md)
- [Start](guide/start.md)
-- docs/index.md --
# Home
-- docs/guide/start.md --
# Start
-- plain-src/index.md --
# Home
